records: UK fixed-originated call volumes decreased by 14.9% year on year in Q1 2026.
There were 29.4 million UK fixed broadband lines at the end of Q1 2026.
UK fixed broadband lines increased by 282,000 year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
UK fixed broadband lines increased by 1.0% year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
Mobile telephony services generated £3.57 billion in UK retail revenues in Q1 2026.
Q1 2026 UK mobile telephony retail revenues increased by £55.6 million year on year.
Q1 2026 UK mobile telephony retail revenues increased by 1.6% year on year.
Average monthly UK mobile retail revenue per subscriber was £13.10 in Q1 2026.
Average monthly UK mobile retail revenue per post-pay subscriber was £15.54 in Q1 2026.
Average monthly UK mobile retail revenue per pre-pay subscriber was £5.40 in Q1 2026.
There were 90.6 million active UK mobile subscriptions excluding M2M at the end of Q1 2026.
Active UK mobile subscriptions excluding M2M increased by 881,000 year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
Active UK mobile subscriptions excluding M2M increased by 1.0% year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
There were 5.2 million dedicated UK mobile broadband subscriptions at the end of Q1 2026.
Dedicated UK mobile broadband subscriptions increased by 421,000 year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
Dedicated UK mobile broadband subscriptions increased by 8.8% year on year at the end of Q1 2026.
UK mobile-originated voice call volumes totalled 36.34 billion minutes in Q1 2026.
UK mobile-originated voice call volumes decreased by 1.76 billion minutes year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile-originated voice call volumes decreased by 4.6% year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile calls to landlines totalled 6.07 billion minutes in Q1 2026.
UK mobile calls to landlines decreased by 7.2% year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile messages including SMS and MMS totalled 4.61 billion in Q1 2026.
UK mobile messages including SMS and MMS decreased by 1.25 billion year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile messages including SMS and MMS decreased by 21.3% year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile data usage totalled 3,042 PB in Q1 2026.
UK mobile data usage increased by 351 PB year on year in Q1 2026.
UK mobile data usage increased by 13.1% year on year in Q1 2026.
The BDUK Address Checker data in July 2026 was taken from the January Open Market Review published in June 2026.
The BDUK Address Checker was scheduled for its next update in September 2026 and then every four months.
BDUK states that it cannot guarantee complete accuracy of an address's gigabit-broadband status because external-source information and supplier plans can change.
